messages:
morgan: Quick sync: product wants a short deprecation playbook for v1 -> v2 that covers code samples, a banner, and an ordered checklist for infra ops. We also need a tiny FAQ entry for customers about model swaps. Can someone draft the copy + snippets?

tara: I can draft the banner + FAQ. What exact legal retention line do we need?

morgan: Legal asked for: 'Request metadata, logs, and minimal payload hashes retained for 30 days for compliance.' Keep it one sentence in the banner.

ben: On SDK snippets: we must stop showing hardcoded params named `invoke`. New v2 uses `responses.create`. Also model aliases may change (rwd-chat -> rwd-conv-v2). I'll prepare JS + Python snippets showing both direct v2 usage and an alias-map fallback.

eli: Ops note: avoid flipping aliases mid-day — suggest 01:00-03:00 UTC. When we flip, routing has a 60s TTL but some nodes cache for longer; include a cache-bust step: `curl -X PURGE https://controlplane.prod.redwood.ai/aliases` or `systemctl reload redwood-routing`.

morgan: Good. Draft snippet examples should include a comment about the deprecation header the gateway will emit: `X-Deprecated-API: v1` so customers can detect usage.

ben: Draft JS snippet (short-term alias map workaround):
```js
// JS fallback: keep calls stable while routing updated
const client = new RedwoodClient({aliasMap: {"rwd-chat": "rwd-conv-v2"}})
await client.responses.create({model: 'rwd-chat', input: 'Hello world'})
```

ben: And direct v2 example:
```js
// direct v2 usage
await client.responses.create({model: 'rwd-conv-v2', input: 'Hello'})
```

tara: Banner draft: "Deprecation notice: v1 Responses and Embeddings APIs will be retired on YYYY-MM-DD. Migrate to v2 for continued support; see our migration guide for code samples, rollback steps, and a recommended maintenance window. Requests and logs retained for 30 days."

eli: Ops checklist to add to the guide: 1) Confirm target time window, 2) Update /etc/redwood/routes/alias-mapping.yaml, 3) Reload routing `systemctl reload redwood-routing`, 4) Run `curl -I` to verify `X-Alias-Version`, 5) Purge caches if necessary, 6) Run docs smoke. Provide exact commands.

morgan: Also add a short troubleshooting blurb for common breakages: stale client alias maps, embedding dim mismatch (add runtime check example), and SDK param rename. Keep it to 3 bullet points.

ben: Python runtime check snippet for embeddings to prevent silent breakage:
```python
# python: verify embedding length before indexing
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='rwd-emb-v2', input='test')
vec = resp.get('embedding')
if not vec or len(vec) not in (768, 1536):
    raise RuntimeError(f'unexpected embedding dim: {len(vec) if vec else 0}')
```

docs-bot: PR #720 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/720 - includes banner, snippets, and ops checklist. CI: docs-smoke queued.

eli: Scheduling note: will perform alias flip at 01:30 UTC tomorrow, watch 01:30-01:45 for errors. If anything fails, revert alias file and `systemctl reload redwood-routing`.

ben: I'll update SDK examples and release a micro patch for JS + Python snippets (no behavior changes, just updated docs strings).

morgan: Action owners: tara (banner + FAQ + PR text), ben (SDK example patches + release), eli (ops flip + purge), docs-bot (smoke). Once smoke passes, merge and announce deprecation banner.

eli: Flip completed in staging, purge run successful. docs-smoke shows example checks green in staging.

docs-bot: CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/docs-smoke/720-7 - smoke passed.

morgan: Thanks everyone. After merge, follow-up: add a short note in the changelog for SDKs pointing developers to runtime checks and alias_map usage. Closing thread; reopen if post-merge errors appear. :white_check_mark:
